Chapter 6813: Summoning Horn

Chapter 6813: Summoning Horn

“Ooo-” Thunder Emperor blew the horn. The sound echoed across Golden Lamp.

“A summon?!” Everyone stopped and stared in the direction of Thunder Kingdom.

“What is happening?” They became startled since it had been a long time since the last call.

Ever since Golden Lamp had the protection of Bear Immortal, a true crisis was rare. Moreover, only emperors and ancient ancestors were permitted to blow this horn. It meant something earthshattering was happening.

Due to the circumstances behind Golden Lamp, its inhabitants shared a strong sense of solidarity.

The moment this horn sounded, one must drop everything and run to the area in preparation for battle.

“Thunder Kingdom!” They shouted.

In just a short time, waves including emperors and ancestors surged for the kingdom.

“Rumble!” Chariots and flying beasts appeared above. Elephants as large as mountains moved thousands of miles with each step. A cultivator left a fiery trail as he flew in the air like a meteor...

Two forces were immense in particular. One traveled like a red tsunami, stopping at the border of Thunder Kingdom. Next, iron trees blossomed.

This was a powerful race. The tree trunk had eyes and a mouth.

“The iron trees are here.” Everyone became emotional. This was the strongest race in Golden Lamp, known for both power and toughness.

A while later, holes appeared in the ground and figures leaped out. This numbered in the millions. The newcomers resembled stone dwarves.

Although they were far shorter than a normal human, their legs were three times as thick, capable of crushing the ground.

“The big foots are here too.” Many became excited to see the oldest race of Golden Lamp.

Rumor has it they were the descendants of Golden Immortal. Although they couldn’t provide any evidence of this connection, they have survived numerous dark ages. They hid underground and had countless passages leading all over this world.

“Rumble!” Just like that, the strongest cultivators in Golden Lamp arrived in Thunder Kingdom.

“Brother Blaze, Thunder, what is the meaning behind this?” A tree seemingly made from red iron came closer.

He was an ancient ancestor - the leader of the iron trees known as “Ironleaf Ancestor”.

“I blew the horn today to let everyone know that Frenzy City is coming. Shall we stop them together?” Thunder Emperor told the crowd.

“Those traitors have returned? How shameless.” A thunderous voice came from the camp of the big foots.

This was an old dwarf whose legs were six times larger than a normal man's legs. They were bigger than his body.

“It appears they won’t yield.” Blaze Ancestor said.

“We are brothers and sisters of Golden Lamp, we share honor and shame, we shall fight the invaders as one. Of course, this unity is not forced upon anyone but a testament to our uncompromising belief. If anyone wishes to leave, they are free to do so.” Thunder Emperor said: “But as an emperor, I am responsible for upholding our belief even if it means dying in battle.”
